title: Listing Highlight: 92' Custom Line Navetta 28 2015
description: Discover the luxurious 92 ft Custom Line Navetta 28 yacht, featuring spacious design, advanced engineering, and innovative exterior for unmatched comfort.
html:
Introducing the 92 ft Custom Line Navetta 28

The Custom Line Navetta 28 is a 28.31-meter yacht that defies its compact size with a spacious and well-thought-out design. Its exterior profile is distinctive, featuring a panoramic dining area with round glass sliding doors that enhance the flexibility of the upper deck. With a top speed of 14 knots and a cruising range of 1400 nautical miles at 10 knots, the yacht is powered by twin 1200 Hp MAN diesel engines, ensuring reliable performance and efficiency.

Luxurious Interior and Guest Accommodations

Inside, the Navetta 28 offers a carefully structured open space that welcomes guests into the salon. The main deck houses the master suite, complete with a large bathroom and walk-in wardrobe. Below deck, four guest cabins provide ample accommodation, with three double beds and a twin cabin fitted with a Pullman bed, all featuring en-suite facilities. This layout allows for comfortable accommodation of up to 11 guests, supported by a crew of five in separate quarters.

Advanced Engineering and Performance Features

The engineering of the Navetta 28 is designed for optimal performance and stability. Equipped with stabilizing fins and two Seakeeper gyro stabilizers, the yacht ensures a smooth ride both underway and at anchor. Twin MAN V8-1200 Hp diesel engines with low hours offer reliable power, complemented by two Kohler generators for consistent energy supply. The yacht also includes a watermaker and a black water treatment system, underscoring its self-sufficiency.

Cutting-Edge Exterior Design and Innovations

The exterior design of the Navetta 28 is marked by innovative features such as the Dual Mode Transom (DMT), a patented system that combines a floodable garage, diving platform, and spacious Beach Club. This feature maximizes the use of space in the stern area, setting a new standard for yachts of this size. The main deck’s continuous window from stern to bow and the unique hull windows with “invisible” portholes further enhance the yacht’s modern aesthetic.

Entertainment, Comfort, and Utility Systems

The Navetta 28 is equipped with a state-of-the-art A/V entertainment system, ensuring guests have access to the latest in onboard entertainment. Tropical air conditioning maintains a comfortable climate, while upgraded systems like CCTV and premium underwater lighting enhance safety and ambiance. Additional features include a wine cellar, Williams 445 Jet Tender, and a wind docking station on the second deck, providing both utility and leisure options.

Navetta 28’s Unique Offerings

The Custom Line Navetta 28 stands out with its combination of innovative design, advanced engineering, and thoughtful accommodations. It offers a unique blend of performance, comfort, and style, making it an attractive option for discerning yacht enthusiasts.
